data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month, independently, and invite each of the other 24 to opt in—not an all-or-nothing deal. State your exact intended catch and any conditions. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250-8k; next stock is500 with75% probability or500-16k with25%. Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but cuts remaining stock by8 and low-recovery stock by16. Long-run gains aren't guaranteed; intentions aren't binding. Other catches require recalculation.
